name: Radiant Cyber-Bismuth Nebula-Colossus
description: A colossal biomechanical titan raymarched from an IFS-folded cyber-bismuth lattice smooth-unioned with nested hopper-crystal octahedra, drifting through a kaleidoscopic symmetry-folded quantum-particle storm. Nebula Density drives a real volumetric accumulation along the march plus a hex-star field, Audio Reactivity wobbles the folds and fires auroral emissive from live bass/mids/treble and engine FFT bins, and Iridiscent Shift phases a thin-film palette with Fresnel hue flip. Adaptive fold/step LOD, soft shadows, mouse-orbit camera with click-dolly, real depth and semantic alpha.
